# Colony Law Enforcement
Colony law enforcement keeps order on the colony: answering calls for help, investigating crimes, making arrests and keeping the criminal records.
## New to the Job? 1. Read [textlink="Colony Law Basics" link="CMUGuideLawBasics"] so you know what you're enforcing.
2. Check your gear in [textlink="Roles and Gear" link="CMUGuideLawRoles"].
3. Learn to [textlink="make an arrest" link="CMUGuideLawArrests"] by the book.
## In This Guide - [textlink="Roles and Gear" link="CMUGuideLawRoles"]: the agencies, your starting kit, the equipment vendor and vehicles. - [textlink="Colony Law Basics" link="CMUGuideLawBasics"]: who's in charge, the classes of crime, weapons law and the ground rules. - [textlink="Radio and 911 Dispatch" link="CMUGuideLawDispatch"]: staying in contact and answering calls for help. - [textlink="Criminal Records" link="CMUGuideLawRecords"]: looking people up, setting statuses and recording crimes. - [textlink="Arrests and Holding" link="CMUGuideLawArrests"]: detaining, restraining, citing and releasing. - [textlink="Forensics" link="CMUGuideForensics"]: gathering evidence with the forensic scanner.
The full law is in the [textlink="Colonial Civil Code" link="AU14CCLaw"].
